reason: The annual report does not contain any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures disclosed by StrongPoint ASA. The document includes operational metrics (NOK 1.3Bn revenue, 497 employees, operations in 9 countries), strategic partnerships (VusionGroup, Sainsbury's), product segments (E-Commerce Logistics, In-store Productivity, Payment Solutions, etc.), and market presence information, but no TAM estimates or market sizing data published by the company itself. The CEO statement mentions revised 2025 financial estimates (NOK 1.5-1.8 billion revenue, 4-6% EBITDA margin) and long-term aspirations (>10% EBITDA margin), but these are company-specific targets, not market opportunity sizes.
